Cause: with standard models Groq put the final usage in the stream's top-level `usage` field, which the adapter reads. Compound models put it under `x_groq.usage` instead — parser never saw it. Patched (r8, hot-loaded): parser now falls back to `x_groq.usage`.

Verified: fresh CTO run just recorded `inputTokens: 37044, outputTokens: 547` in its usageJson — the all-time counter will move again from here.

One caveat: tokens from the compound runs between the model switch and this fix were never recorded and can't be backfilled — the counter is permanently short by that gap.
